performance.verdict: No paid activity in 28 days; organic collapse accelerating — revenue clock running.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days: Meta $0, Google $0. No leads generated. August prove-it month is passing with no paid engine running.
Overdue: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open — without it, leads arriving by phone cannot be counted toward the client's scoreboard.
Overdue: Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) not marked complete — GHL shows 96 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments, raising data-integrity risk.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on 3 of the last 3 days (Aug 28–30), vs a rolling average near 7–10. 3-day signal confirms organic freefall, not noise.
GA4 sessions averaged only 5 over the last 3 days (Aug 28–30) vs a 45-day mean near 11 — search clicks also hit 0 for two of those days, reinforcing site visibility drop.

suggestions.text: Immediately confirm why paid campaigns are at $0 spend and reactivate or flag for Sohib — every day costs prove-it month runway.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have recorded $0 spend across all 28 days through Aug 30 — no leads have been generated during Full Smile's prove-it month. Confirm whether campaigns are intentionally paused or broken, then reactivate or escalate to Sohib immediately. Success check: at least $1 of tracked spend and ≥1 lead form submission confirmed live by 2026-09-03. If campaigns cannot reactivate by Sep 2, Sohib must be informed same day.

suggestions.text: Close the phone-match attribution gap (overdue Aug 7) — without it, phone leads are invisible on the client's scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution deliverable was due 2026-08-07 and remains open. Without it, inbound calls — which GBP logged 57 of in 28 days — cannot be credited to any campaign and are invisible on the client's lead-to-patient scoreboard. Assign to Attribution team for completion by 2026-09-03. Success check: call source is captured and tagged in GHL for all new inbound calls from that date forward.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions over next 3 days; 0 actions on Aug 28–30 may signal listing suppression — re-check Sep 3.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on Aug 28, 29, and 30 — three consecutive days, which is a confirmed signal rather than noise. The 28-day total of 196 actions (57 calls, 92 directions, 47 web clicks) shows the listing was functioning, making a sudden collapse notable. Monitor GBP Insights daily and check for any listing suspension or ownership flags. Re-check on 2026-09-03; if actions remain at 0, escalate to GBP remediation immediately.
